test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with template ambiguity
test_cases.description: A verbose customer requests a quote for several catalog items, providing detailed context about their business and previous purchases, but does not specify which customer template should be used. The request is written in a way that triggers the need for template selection intervention due to multiple possible templates.

initial_turn.subject: Quote Request for Toys and Apparel – Template Clarification Needed
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I am reaching out from Lyn Ventures to request a sales quote for a few items we are considering for our upcoming seasonal promotion. We have previously purchased both toys and apparel from your company, and our business operates across several divisions, which sometimes leads to confusion regarding which customer profile or template should be used for quotes and orders. To ensure accuracy, please advise if you need any additional information to select the correct template for this request.

For this quote, we are interested in the following items:
- MagicToyland Adventure Doll
- T-Shirt (we have ordered different types before, so please clarify which variant or template applies)
- JoySprout Toy Bicycle

If you require further details about our account or purchasing history to determine the right template, let me know. We want to make sure the quote is generated under the appropriate context for our records.

Best regards,
Lyn Ventures

test_cases.name: Verbose quote request with template ambiguity
test_cases.description: A verbose and polite customer requests a quote, providing detailed context and mentioning that their organization may have multiple customer templates, which could require clarification before proceeding.

initial_turn.subject: Request for Sales Quote – Possible Multiple Customer Templates
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out to request a formal sales quote for several items that we are considering for an upcoming project. Before proceeding, I wanted to mention that our organization, MaxoMart, has previously worked with your company under different divisions and billing addresses. As a result, I believe there may be multiple customer templates associated with our account, and I am not certain which one would be most appropriate for this particular quote.

For the quote itself, could you please include the following items:
- 10 units of Rug (I noticed there are several variants, such as AITEM-0030, AITEM-0031, and AITEM-0032; I am not sure which one matches our previous orders, so please advise).
- 5 Generic Golden T-Shirts
- 2 WonderWash Washing Machines

If you require any additional information to determine the correct customer template or need clarification on the Rug variant, please let me know. I appreciate your assistance and look forward to your guidance so we can proceed efficiently.

Best regards,
Mario Adams

initial_turn.subject: Request for Quote – Fresh Foods North Europe
initial_turn.body:
Hi there,

I hope this finds you well! We’re gearing up for a seasonal promotion and need to get a quote for a few items. I’m reaching out on behalf of Fresh Foods North Europe, but please note that we sometimes operate under different regional accounts, so let me know if you need any extra info to identify the right customer profile for us.

Here’s what we’re looking for:
- Apples (for our fruit baskets, please quote for 100 units)
- Watermelon (quantity: 25)
- T-Shirt (we’re interested in the basic style, but I noticed there are several T-Shirts in your catalog—can you clarify which one is most commonly ordered by food retailers, or do you need us to specify the exact item number?)

If you need any more details about our account or previous orders, just ask. We want to make sure the quote is set up under the correct template so everything matches our usual billing and shipping arrangements.

Best regards,
Fresh Foods North Europe

initial_turn.body:
Hello,

I need a quote right away for the following items, and I really don’t have time for unnecessary back-and-forth. Please process this as quickly as possible. For context, we’ve ordered similar products before, so you should have our details on file somewhere. I’m not sure why this always takes so long, but let’s try to keep it simple this time.

Here’s what I need:
- 10x Pizza (I don’t care which, just the regular ones you have)
- 5x T-Shirt (again, the standard T-Shirts, whatever you usually provide)
- 1x WonderWagon Pull-Along Train

If you need any more info, please don’t drag this out—just get me the quote or tell me what’s missing in one go. I expect a prompt response.

Dunder Mifflin

Best regards,
Dunder Mifflin
